report.summary: Chunk defines ProbeResult, Comparison, and CanaryRun dataclasses with docstrings and methods; all claims are kept or uncheckable.

handoff.purpose: Define ProbeResult, Comparison, and CanaryRun dataclasses with validation and summary methods.

symbols.name: ProbeResult
symbols.note: Dataclass representing one (lane, probe) outcome with fields and validation.

symbols.name: ProbeResult.to_record
symbols.note: Returns dict representation with run_id and ts.

symbols.name: Comparison
symbols.note: Frozen dataclass holding this run's result against trailing history for same triple.

symbols.name: CanaryRun
symbols.note: Dataclass representing a complete canary run with results and comparisons.

symbols.name: CanaryRun.summary
symbols.note: Returns dict with counts of asked, could_not_ask, by_status, failures, regressions.

symbols.name: CanaryRun.regressions
symbols.note: Returns tuple of Comparisons where c.regressed, optionally filtered by severity.

claims.text: One (lane, probe) outcome. Carries WHICH check failed, not just that one did.
claims.why: Class has field 'failed_check' to carry which check failed.

claims.text: Did a prompt actually reach a model? ``unavailable`` means it did not.
This run's result against the trailing history for the same triple.
claims.why: No code in this chunk defines 'trailing history' or how Comparison is populated.

claims.text: Counts that keep "could not ask" apart from "answer was wrong". ``asked`` and ``could_not_ask`` are separate top-level keys and ``by_status`` reports every member of the closed vocabulary individually. There is deliberately no combined "failures" number: a single number is exactly where the two get merged.
claims.why: Summary returns separate keys 'asked' and 'could_not_ask', and 'by_status' with counts per status; no combined failures key.

observations.what: ProbeResult.__post_init__ references CANARY_STATUSES and SEVERITIES which are not defined in this chunk.
ProbeResult.to_record references SCHEMA_VERSION and REPLY_TRIM not defined in this chunk.
CanaryRun.summary references FAILING_STATUSES not defined in this chunk.
